name: abderrahmane-scanner

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:fixtures: python3 test/make_fixture.py test/fixtures/strap.y4m && python3 test/make_fixture.py test/fixtures/strap-vertical.y4m --vertical && python3 test/make_fixture.py test/fixtures/strap-fast.y4m --fast
scripts.test:e2e: node test/e2e.mjs && node test/e2e.mjs --vertical && node test/e2e.mjs --fast

description: Mobile-first PWA that scans long, narrow objects with the phone camera and measures them.
